system.longDesc:
A muzzle attachment baffles the expanding gases from a gunshot better than a modern-day flash suppressor. In addition to having the sound effects of a suppressor (see p. 79 of Modern AGE) the advanced silencer changes the difficulty to hear the gunshot from automatic to a TN 9 Perception (Hearing) test. Advanced silencers are common accessories for assassins.

Resources TN 13.
